_comment: Hand-maintained by whoever launches a porting batch — never edited by a porting agent itself. See docs/parallel-porting.md. Components not listed here are simply not started; see wcag-data/ for the full CivicTheme component list.

accordion.note: Merged to main via PR #4. First component using @zag-js for state. Introduced the shared src/lib/zag adapter, the ct-accordion + ct-accordion-item parent/child pattern, and the shared color.light/color.dark/typography token tier — treat as the reference example for future stateful/composite components, not just a status entry.

grid.note: Predates the scaffold-based process (no schema/test/e2e/config). Not in scope for the parallel port list until retrofitted.

region.note: Predates the scaffold-based process (no schema/test/e2e). Not in scope for the parallel port list until retrofitted.

tag.note: First parallel-porting dry run, validating docs/parallel-porting.md before merging parallel-porting-infra. Merged cleanly; also surfaced and fixed the worktree/Fractal dot-path bug (see lab.cjs).

link.note: First parallel-porting dry run, validating docs/parallel-porting.md before merging parallel-porting-infra. Sequential merge after tag produced exactly one trivial tokens.json conflict (both added an adjacent top-level key), as expected.

icon.note: Not a CivicTheme component in its own right — a shared ct-icon primitive inlining CivicTheme's SVG icon set, wired into button/link/tag's previously-dangling icon prop. Merged via PR #6/#7. Established the pattern (and the SKILL.md/checklist steps) for checking whether a new/changed component is composed inside another component's shadow DOM and regenerating that consumer's Linux visual-regression baseline via CI's workflow_dispatch, not locally.

heading.note: Merged to main via PR #12. A second bulk-batch worktree (CT_FRACTAL_PORT 3010) independently ported the same component after forking before this merge landed; since it was fully redundant, that worktree and its branch were removed rather than reconciled.

Gained a `no-margin` property in batch 6 wave 1b (PR #37) so checkbox/radio can compose it beside a control without its default label-above-a-field bottom margin — that margin lives inside ct-label's own shadow root and can only be cancelled by ct-label itself.

select.note: 2026-07-24 bulk batch 6, wave 1a (01-atoms). No civictheme:* deps. Composite ct-select + ct-select-option/ct-select-optgroup (native <select> can't slot light DOM). Added global font.average-character-width token. Flagged that a shadow-DOM-rendered form control can't be associated with an external <label for>; uses aria-label instead — relevant to the future civictheme:field molecule. Integrated via batch-6-form-atoms, PR #36.

input.note: 2026-07-24 bulk batch 6, wave 1a (01-atoms). No civictheme:* deps. Needed because civictheme:field composes it — unblocks the field molecule in a future wave. Independently hit the same shadow-DOM label-association limitation as select. Integrated via batch-6-form-atoms, PR #36.

field-description.note: 2026-07-24 bulk batch 6, wave 1a (01-atoms). No civictheme:* deps. Integrated via batch-6-form-atoms, PR #36.

checkbox.note: 2026-07-26 bulk batch 6, wave 1b (01-atoms). Composes a real civictheme:label (not aria-label fallback) — surfaced the same cross-shadow-root for/id gap as select/input, mitigated with an auto-defaulted aria-label plus a manual click-forward handler so clicking the label text still toggles the box. The porting agent's `.ct-checkbox + ct-label { display: inline }` layout fix looked right in isolated review but was a no-op in a real browser: a custom element whose shadow root renders block-level content gets blockified regardless of a `display: inline` override from outside, so the label rendered below the box, not beside it — caught visually post-merge, fixed on the integration branch by making `:host` itself `display: inline-flex` (see also ct-label's new `no-margin` property). Completes 01-atoms; unblocks civictheme:field alongside radio. Integrated via batch-6-wave-1b, PR #37.

radio.note: 2026-07-26 bulk batch 6, wave 1b (01-atoms). Composes a real civictheme:label, same for/id mitigation as checkbox. Its label-beside-control flex layout was mostly right (unlike checkbox's, its `:host` really was flex) but `:host` used `display: inline-block` with `vertical-align: top` on both children, top-aligning the shorter label box against the taller circle instead of centering — fixed by making `:host` itself `display: inline-flex; align-items: center` too, matching checkbox. Bigger finding: same-name radios in separate shadow roots don't natively group for mutual exclusivity or arrow-key roving — mutual exclusivity patched via JS, roving-tabindex not reproduced. Flagged as needing a future ct-radio-group molecule (accordion/accordion-item shape). Integrated via batch-6-wave-1b, PR #37.

fieldset.note: 2026-07-26 bulk batch 6, wave 1b (01-atoms). Composes civictheme:label (tag=legend), civictheme:paragraph, civictheme:field-message, all already merged. Caught and fixed a real bug in the port itself (unset required-text was blanking ct-label's own default) plus added an aria-label mirror for the legend accessible-name gap. No wcag-data/fieldset.json written yet (none upstream either) — flagged as a follow-up needing human review. Integrated via batch-6-wave-1b, PR #37.

iframe.note: 2026-07-26 bulk batch 6, wave 1b (01-atoms). No civictheme:* deps. Added a frameTitle prop (not in upstream's component.yml) for an accessible name. Flagged a real gap in the shared a11y audit infra: axe-core's frame-title rule isn't mapped in .claude/skills/sonnet-a11y-audit/references/axe-earl-map.json, so both the a11y-conditional test tier and audit-component.mjs currently miss it — needs a human-reviewed map addition. Integrated via batch-6-wave-1b, PR #37.

popover.note: 2026-07-26 bulk batch 6, wave 1b (01-atoms). Composes civictheme:link as its Zag.js (@zag-js/popover) trigger, following the ct-tooltip reference pattern. Extended the shared ct-link component (aria-expanded/aria-haspopup/aria-controls passthrough, delegatesFocus on its shadow root, implicit role=button when href-less) since Zag's trigger machinery needs to reach ct-link's own shadow-rendered <a> — additive only, full suite (290/290 on the merged batch) confirms no regression to any other ct-link consumer. Integrated via batch-6-wave-1b, PR #37.
